product_overview: FindCo is an Indian social companionship platform where clients can discover verified buddies for outings, events, and everyday plans. Users can browse companions, request activities, manage escrow-protected bookings, and review cryptographic trust details from a single-page app.
core_goals: Sign in or register as a Client or Buddy and access personalized experiences.
Browse verified companions across Indian metros by city, activity, rate, and trust indicators.
Post and manage activity hangout requests from the feed.
Review Hallmark trust and cryptographic verification details for companions.
Choose and purchase a BuddySearch membership tier, including promo-code discounts.
Use escrow-safe booking flow with in-person PIN verification to release funds.

features.name: Member Authentication & Session Management
features.description: Users can sign in or register as either a Client or Buddy to unlock personalized areas of the app.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Open the sign-in experience -> Choose Client or Buddy intent -> Enter email or Indian 10-digit mobile number -> Enter OTP or password -> See the personalized dashboard
Navigate to / -> Open the sign-in experience -> Choose Client or Buddy intent -> Enter Google account credentials -> Complete authentication -> See the personalized dashboard

features.name: Discover Verified Companions
features.description: Users can browse, filter, and inspect verified companions across Indian metros and activity categories.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Filter companions by city -> Filter companions by activity category -> Review hourly rate, bio, star badges, and trust seal -> Open a companion card -> Inspect Hallmark trust credential -> Initiate messaging or booking
Navigate to / -> Browse the companion list -> Open a companion card -> Review the companion's bio, reviews, and booking options

features.name: Activity Feed & Requests
features.description: Authenticated users can create new hangout requests and browse open activity requests in the feed.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Open the activity request posting experience -> Select or review the prefilled activity details -> Choose activity category, duration, city, and hourly budget -> Submit the request -> See the request published in the feed

Navigate to / -> Tap an activity from the Cozy Activities card -> See the post request modal open with prefilled details -> Complete the request details -> Submit the request -> See the request published in the feed

features.name: Dual-Handshake Escrow Booking & SafeGuard
features.description: Authenticated users can review escrow-locked booking details and release funds after in-person PIN verification.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Open the member dashboard -> Review upcoming bookings and escrow-locked balance -> Enter the companion's 4-digit handshake PIN -> Verify the PIN -> See booking status change from LOCKED to RELEASED
Navigate to / -> Open the member dashboard -> Review the escrow SafeGuard details -> Enter an incorrect 4-digit handshake PIN -> See the PIN verification fail

features.name: Hallmark Trust & Cryptographic Verification
features.description: Users can inspect a companion's trust badge to review verification details without exposing sensitive personal numbers.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Open a companion's Hallmark trust badge -> Review the cryptographic fingerprint, trust score, and verification timestamp -> View masked Aadhaar details and sovereign security seal
Navigate to / -> Open a companion's Hallmark trust badge -> Review the companion's trust credential details -> Close the trust view and return to browsing

features.name: BuddySearch Membership Plans & VIP Tiers
features.description: Users can compare subscription tiers, apply a promo code, and unlock membership benefits.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Open the subscription plans experience -> Switch between 3-month, 6-month, 12-month, and Lifetime VIP tiers -> Review plan pricing -> Apply promo code BUDDY50 -> See the discounted price and confetti animation
Navigate to / -> Open the subscription plans experience -> Review Basic, Standard, Premium, and Star Member VIP options -> Select a tier -> Unlock the membership plan

features.name: Real-Time Chat & Counter-Offer Negotiation
features.description: Authenticated users can message companions and negotiate pricing or scheduling in real time.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Open the chats experience -> Select a chat conversation from the sidebar -> Type and send a text message -> Send an hourly counter-offer -> Accept or decline the counter-offer
Navigate to / -> Open the chats experience -> Select a chat conversation from the sidebar -> Type and send a message -> See the message appear in the conversation
